project_type: Static HTML/CSS/JS site hosted on GitHub Pages — no build step, no bundler, no framework
build_system: None — files are served directly. No package.json, no Makefile. 'Build' means open the file in a browser.
test_framework: None — verification is manual browser inspection. No automated test runner exists.
build_command: N/A — open HTML files directly in a browser or serve with: npx serve . (optional, no install needed)
verification_instructions: 1. Open the modified HTML file in a browser. 2. Check the browser console for JS errors. 3. For Supabase-dependent features, confirm network requests succeed in the Network tab. 4. For admin features, sign in with a Supabase Email/Password admin account.
environment_constraints: GitHub Pages static hosting — no server-side code. All data is fetched client-side from Supabase REST API. The Supabase anon key is intentionally public (RLS enforces access). Do not add npm dependencies or build steps.
contribution_requirements: Follow the existing ES5-compatible vanilla JS style (no arrow functions at top level, no let/const, no template literals in IE-sensitive paths). Inline all CSS in <style> blocks in each HTML file. Copy nav/footer HTML verbatim from shop.html when creating new pages.
key_patterns: 1. supaFetch() in admin.html wraps fetch() with Authorization Bearer + apikey headers; public pages use anonymous fetch() with just apikey header. 2. Images uploaded via POST to /storage/v1/object/{bucket}/{path}, public URL is /storage/v1/object/public/{bucket}/{path}. 3. Tab panels use class 'tab-panel on' toggled by data-tab attribute on buttons. 4. Toast notifications via toast(msg) function. 5. Mobile menu built as JS string injected into mm.innerHTML; desktop nav is static HTML. 6. All CSS in page-level <style> tag — no external stylesheet. 7. Supabase REST API: GET /rest/v1/{table}?select=cols&filter=val, POST /rest/v1/{table} with Prefer:return=representation, PATCH /rest/v1/{table}?id=eq.{id}.

storage_upload_pattern: fetch(SUPA_URL + '/storage/v1/object/{bucket}/{path}', { method:'POST', headers:{ apikey, Authorization, Content-Type, 'x-upsert':'true' }, body: file }) then public URL = SUPA_URL + '/storage/v1/object/public/{bucket}/{path}'
